# CVForge AI Instructions

You are contributing to CVForge.

Project goals:

- Build ATS-friendly LaTeX resumes.
- Preserve clean, maintainable code.
- Never invent user experience or achievements.
- Prefer quantified bullet points where possible.
- Keep LaTeX modular by separating content from templates.
- Do not modify templates unless explicitly requested.
- Prefer reusable components over duplication.
- Write concise, professional English.
- Optimize resumes for readability and ATS compatibility.
